Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.delta_rank: Perturbed target rank minus original rank; rank is one plus the number preceding the target under deterministic ordering. Sampled diagnostic rank, not benchmark HR@10 or full-catalog position.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.delta_target_score: Perturbed target score minus original target score on identical candidates.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.overlap_at_10: Intersection size of original and perturbed top ten divided by ten; null for candidate pools smaller than ten.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.state_distance: One minus final-feature cosine similarity; null if either norm is zero.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.deletion: For n>=2, remove exactly k=min(3,max(1,n//4)) oldest versus latest observed items, retaining the same target.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.shuffle: Permute all but the latest input. Short older histories, unchanged shuffles and duplicate-containing unchanged shuffles are counted separately; no-ops remain in summaries.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.ties: Exact score equality; target tie counts exclude the target itself; boundary ties compare ranks ten and eleven and are undefined when no rank eleven exists.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.aggregation: Average prefixes within each identified user before category means and 1000 user-bootstrap draws. Anonymous samples receive descriptive prefix means without intervals. Each metric reports its own defined support.
Movies_and_TV:history_perturbations.limits: Training-only reliance evidence subject to prefix memorization. Fixed-target perturbations may be implausible; shuffles may violate unobserved catalog availability. No intent, compatibility, causal or accuracy-gain claims. Sparse joint cells need caution. Repeat targets are separate from strict unseen-item simulator recommendations. The benchmark and its candidates are unchanged; repeated validation selection can overfit.
